props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new value whenever it changes.

props.name: step
props.description: Amount the value changes by per step.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops the user from changing the slider.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the value bubble while dragging or focused.

props.name: formatValue
props.description: Turns the value into the text shown in the bubble.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required: names the slider for screen readers.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes added to the outer element.
